traditions.VUL: Qui díligit disciplínam , díligit sciéntiam :
traditions.KJV: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge :

1.english_reference: but he that hateth reproof [ is ] brutish

traditions.VUL: qui autem odit increpatiónes , insípiens est .
traditions.KJV: but he that hateth reproof [ is ] brutish .

2.english_reference: A good [ man ] obtaineth favour of the LORD

traditions.LXX: κρείσσων ὁ εὑρὼν χάριν παρὰ Κυρίῳ ,
traditions.VUL: Qui bonus est , háuriet grátiam a Dómino :
traditions.KJV: A good [ man ] obtaineth favour of the LORD :

2.english_reference: but a man of wicked devices will he condemn

traditions.VUL: qui autem confídit in cogitatiónibus suis ímpie agit .
traditions.KJV: but a man of wicked devices will he condemn .

3.english_reference: A man shall not be established by wickedness

traditions.VUL: Non roborábitur homo ex impietáte :
traditions.KJV: A man shall not be established by wickedness :

3.english_reference: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved

traditions.LXX: αἱ δὲ ῥίζαι τῶν δικαίων οὐκ ἐξαρθήσονται
traditions.VUL: et radix iustórum non commovébitur .
traditions.KJV: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved .

4.english_reference: A virtuous woman [ is ] a crown to her husband

traditions.LXX: γυνὴ ἀνδρεία στέφανος τῷ ἀνδρὶ αὐτῆς ·
traditions.VUL: Múlier díligens , coróna est viro suo :
traditions.KJV: A virtuous woman [ is ] a crown to her husband :

4.english_reference: but she that maketh ashamed [ is ] as rottenness in his bones

traditions.WLC: וּ כְ רָקָ֖ב בְּ עַצְמוֹתָ֣י ו מְבִישָֽׁה
traditions.LXX: ὥσπερ δὲ ἐν ξύλῳ σκώληξ , οὕτως ἄνδρα ἀπόλλυσιν γυνὴ κακοποιός
traditions.VUL: et putrédo in óssibus eius , quæ confusióne res dignas gerit .
traditions.KJV: but she that maketh ashamed [ is ] as rottenness in his bones .

5.english_reference: The thoughts of the righteous [ are ] right

traditions.VUL: Cogitatiónes iustórum iudícia :
traditions.KJV: The thoughts of the righteous [ are ] right : [ but ]

5.english_reference: [ but ] the counsels of the wicked [ are ] deceit

traditions.VUL: et consília impiórum fraudulénta .
traditions.KJV: the counsels of the wicked [ are ] deceit .

6.english_reference: The words of the wicked [ are ] to lie in wait for blood

traditions.VUL: Verba impiórum insidiántur sánguini :
traditions.KJV: The words of the wicked [ are ] to lie in wait for blood :

6.english_reference: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them

traditions.VUL: os iustórum liberábit eos .
traditions.KJV: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them .

7.english_reference: The wicked are overthrown , and [ are ] not

traditions.VUL: Verte ímpios , et non erunt :
traditions.KJV: The wicked are overthrown , and [ are ] not :

7.english_reference: but the house of the righteous shall stand

traditions.VUL: domus autem iustórum permanébit .
traditions.KJV: but the house of the righteous shall stand .

8.english_reference: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom

traditions.WLC: לְֽ פִי שִׂ֭כְל וֹ יְהֻלַּל אִ֑ישׁ
traditions.VUL: Doctrína sua noscétur vir :
traditions.KJV: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom :

8.english_reference: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised

traditions.WLC: וְ נַעֲוֵה לֵ֝֗ב יִהְיֶ֥ה לָ בֽוּז
traditions.VUL: qui autem vanus et excors est , patébit contémptui .
traditions.KJV: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised .

9.english_reference: [ He that is ] despised , and hath a servant , [ is ] better

traditions.WLC: ט֣וֹב נִ֭קְלֶה וְ עֶ֣בֶד ל֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: κρείσσων ἀνὴρ ἐν ἀτιμίᾳ δουλεύων ἑαυτῷ ,
traditions.VUL: Mélior est pauper et suffíciens sibi ,
traditions.KJV: [ He that is ] despised , and hath a servant , [ is ] better

9.english_reference: than he that honoureth himself , and lacketh bread

traditions.LXX: ἢ τιμὴν ἑαυτῷ περιτιθεὶς καὶ προσδεόμενος ἄρτου
traditions.VUL: quam gloriósus et índigens pane .
traditions.KJV: than he that honoureth himself , and lacketh bread .

10.english_reference: A righteous [ man ] regardeth the life of his beast

traditions.VUL: Novit iustus iumentórum suórum ánimas :
traditions.KJV: A righteous [ man ] regardeth the life of his beast :

10.english_reference: but the tender mercies of the wicked [ are ] cruel

traditions.LXX: τὰ δὲ σπλάγχνα τῶν ἀσεβῶν ἀνελεήμονα
traditions.VUL: víscera autem impiórum crudélia .
traditions.KJV: but the tender mercies of the wicked [ are ] cruel .

11.english_reference: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread

traditions.LXX: ὁ ἐργαζόμενος τὴν ἑαυτοῦ γῆν ἐμπλησθήσεται ἄρτων ,
traditions.VUL: Qui operátur terram suam , satiábitur pánibus :
traditions.KJV: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread :

11.english_reference: but he that followeth vain [ persons is ] void of understanding

traditions.LXX: οἱ δὲ διώκοντες μάταια ἐνδεεῖς φρενῶν .
traditions.VUL: qui autem sectátur ótium , stultíssimus est .
traditions.KJV: but he that followeth vain [ persons is ] void of understanding .

traditions.LXX: ὅς ἐστιν ἡδὺς ἐν οἴνων διατριβαῖς , ἐν τοῖς ἑαυτοῦ ὀχυρώμασιν καταλείψει ἀτιμίαν
traditions.VUL: Qui suávis est in vini demoratiónibus , in suis munitiónibus relínquit contuméliam .

12.english_reference: The wicked desireth the net of evil [ men ]

traditions.VUL: Desidérium ímpii muniméntum est pessimórum :
traditions.KJV: The wicked desireth the net of evil [ men ] :

12.english_reference: but the root of the righteous yieldeth [ fruit ]

traditions.LXX: αἱ δὲ ῥίζαι τῶν εὐσεβῶν ἐν ὀχυρώμασιν
traditions.VUL: radix autem iustórum profíciet .
traditions.KJV: but the root of the righteous yieldeth [ fruit ] .

13.english_reference: The wicked is snared by the transgression of [ his ] lips

traditions.LXX: δι᾽ ἁμαρτίαν χειλέων ἐμπίπτει εἰς παγίδας ἁμαρτωλός ,
traditions.VUL: Propter peccáta labiórum ruína próximat malo :
traditions.KJV: The wicked is snared by the transgression of [ his ] lips :

13.english_reference: but the just shall come out of trouble

traditions.VUL: effúgiet autem iustus de angústia .
traditions.KJV: but the just shall come out of trouble .

traditions.LXX: ὁ βλέπων λεῖα ἐλεηθήσεται , ὁ δὲ συναντῶν ἐν πύλαις ἐκθλίψει ψυχάς

14.english_reference: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of [ his ] mouth

traditions.WLC: מִ פְּרִ֣י פִי אִ֭ישׁ יִשְׂבַּע ט֑וֹב
traditions.LXX: ἀπὸ καρπῶν στόματος ψυχὴ ἀνδρὸς πλησθήσεται ἀγαθῶν ,
traditions.VUL: De fructu oris sui unusquísque replébitur bonis ,
traditions.KJV: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of [ his ] mouth :

14.english_reference: and the recompence of a man ’s hands shall be rendered unto him

traditions.WLC: וּ גְמ֥וּל יְדֵי אָ֝דָ֗ם ישוב לֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: ἀνταπόδομα δὲ χειλέων αὐτοῦ δοθήσεται αὐτῷ
traditions.VUL: et iuxta ópera mánuum suárum retribuétur ei .
traditions.KJV: and the recompence of a man ’s hands shall be rendered unto him .

15.english_reference: The way of a fool [ is ] right in his own eyes

traditions.VUL: Via stulti recta in óculis eius :
traditions.KJV: The way of a fool [ is ] right in his own eyes :

15.english_reference: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel [ is ] wise

traditions.WLC: ו וְ שֹׁמֵ֖עַ לְ עֵצָ֣ה חָכָֽם
traditions.VUL: qui autem sápiens est , audit consília .
traditions.KJV: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel [ is ] wise .

16.english_reference: A fool ’s wrath is presently known

traditions.WLC: אֱוִ֗יל בַּ֭ יּוֹם יִוָּדַ֣ע כַּעְס֑ וֹ
traditions.VUL: Fátuus statim índicat iram suam :
traditions.KJV: A fool ’s wrath is presently known :

16.english_reference: but a prudent [ man ] covereth shame

traditions.LXX: κρύπτει δὲ τὴν ἑαυτοῦ ἀτιμίαν πανοῦργος
traditions.VUL: qui autem dissímulat iniúriam , cállidus est .
traditions.KJV: but a prudent [ man ] covereth shame .

17.english_reference: [ He that ] speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness

traditions.VUL: Qui quod novit lóquitur , index iustítiæ est :
traditions.KJV: [ He that ] speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness :

traditions.LXX: ὁ δὲ μάρτυς τῶν ἀδίκων δόλιος
traditions.VUL: qui autem mentítur , testis est frauduléntus .
traditions.KJV: but a false witness deceit .

18.english_reference: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword

traditions.VUL: Est qui promíttit , et quasi gládio púngitur consciéntiæ :
traditions.KJV: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword :

18.english_reference: but the tongue of the wise [ is ] health

traditions.VUL: lingua autem sapiéntium sánitas est .
traditions.KJV: but the tongue of the wise [ is ] health .

19.english_reference: The lip of truth shall be established for ever

traditions.VUL: Lábium veritátis firmum erit in perpétuum :
traditions.KJV: The lip of truth shall be established for ever :

19.english_reference: but a lying tongue [ is ] but for a moment

traditions.LXX: μάρτυς δὲ ταχὺς γλῶσσαν ἔχει ἄδικον
traditions.VUL: qui autem testis est repentínus , concínnat linguam mendácii .
traditions.KJV: but a lying tongue [ is ] but for a moment .

20.english_reference: Deceit [ is ] in the heart of them that imagine evil

traditions.VUL: Dolus in corde cogitántium mala :
traditions.KJV: Deceit [ is ] in the heart of them that imagine evil :

20.english_reference: but to the counsellers of peace [ is ] joy

traditions.VUL: qui autem pacis íneunt consília , séquitur eos gáudium .
traditions.KJV: but to the counsellers of peace [ is ] joy .

21.english_reference: There shall no evil happen to the just

traditions.WLC: לֹא יְאֻנֶּ֣ה לַ צַּדִּ֣יק כָּל אָ֑וֶן
traditions.LXX: οὐκ ἀρέσει τῷ δικαίῳ οὐδὲν ἄδικον ,
traditions.VUL: Non contristábit iustum quidquid ei accíderit :
traditions.KJV: There shall no evil happen to the just :

21.english_reference: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief

traditions.VUL: ímpii autem replebúntur malo .
traditions.KJV: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief .

22.english_reference: Lying lips [ are ] abomination to the LORD

traditions.VUL: Abominátio est Dómino lábia mendácia :
traditions.KJV: Lying lips [ are ] abomination to the LORD :

22.english_reference: but they that deal truly [ are ] his delight

traditions.LXX: ὁ δὲ ποιῶν πίστεις δεκτὸς παρ᾽ αὐτῷ
traditions.VUL: qui autem fidéliter agunt , placent ei .
traditions.KJV: but they that deal truly [ are ] his delight .

traditions.VUL: Homo versútus celat sciéntiam :
traditions.KJV: A prudent man concealeth knowledge :

23.english_reference: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness

traditions.VUL: et cor insipiéntium próvocat stultítiam .
traditions.KJV: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness .

24.english_reference: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule

traditions.VUL: Manus fórtium dominábitur :
traditions.KJV: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule :

24.english_reference: but the slothful shall be under tribute

traditions.VUL: quæ autem remíssa est , tribútis sérviet .
traditions.KJV: but the slothful shall be under tribute .

25.english_reference: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop

traditions.WLC: דְּאָגָ֣ה בְ לֶב אִ֣ישׁ יַשְׁחֶ֑ נָּה
traditions.LXX: φοβερὸς λόγος καρδίαν ταράσσει ἀνδρὸς δικαίου ,
traditions.VUL: Mœror in corde viri humiliábit illum ,
traditions.KJV: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop :

25.english_reference: but a good word maketh it glad

traditions.VUL: et sermóne bono lætificábitur .
traditions.KJV: but a good word maketh it glad .

26.english_reference: The righteous [ is ] more excellent than his neighbour

traditions.VUL: Qui négligit damnum propter amícum , iustus est :
traditions.KJV: The righteous [ is ] more excellent than his neighbour :

26.english_reference: but the way of the wicked seduceth them

traditions.LXX: ἡ δὲ ὁδὸς τῶν ἀσεβῶν πλανήσει αὐτούς
traditions.VUL: iter autem impiórum decípiet eos .
traditions.KJV: but the way of the wicked seduceth them .

27.english_reference: The slothful [ man ] roasteth not that which he took in hunting

traditions.VUL: Non invéniet frauduléntus lucrum :
traditions.KJV: The slothful [ man ] roasteth not that which he took in hunting :

27.english_reference: but the substance of a diligent man [ is ] precious

traditions.VUL: et substántia hóminis erit auri prétium .
traditions.KJV: but the substance of a diligent man [ is ] precious .

28.english_reference: In the way of righteousness [ is ] life

traditions.VUL: In sémita iustítiæ , vita :
traditions.KJV: In the way of righteousness [ is ] life ;

28.english_reference: and [ in ] the pathway [ thereof there is ] no death

traditions.VUL: iter autem dévium ducit ad mortem .
traditions.KJV: and [ in ] the pathway [ thereof there is ] no death .
